content.value_statement: Creators often know how to make Notion pages but struggle to turn them into paid products. This skill gives a practical launch system for design, pricing, marketplaces, marketing, support, and scaling.
actual_capabilities: Define a paid Notion template package with core pages, documentation, examples, and bonuses.
Compare pricing tiers, bundles, free lead magnets, and value-based price anchors.
Plan sales channels across Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Notion Marketplace, and owned websites.
Identify launch risks such as weak audience, unclear positioning, support load, and marketplace dependence.
Create support, documentation, FAQ, and update strategies for template customers.
limitations: Does not create or publish a live Notion workspace by itself.
Does not connect to Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Stripe, or Notion APIs.
Cannot guarantee marketplace approval, customer demand, or revenue results.
Provides business guidance, not legal, tax, or payment compliance advice.

use_cases.title: Validate a Template Idea
use_cases.description: Turn a rough Notion concept into a focused product with a clear buyer, promise, and package structure.

use_cases.title: Set Pricing and Bundles
use_cases.description: Choose entry, pro, and premium offers using value anchors, included assets, and bundle discounts.

use_cases.title: Build a Repeatable Launch Plan
use_cases.description: Plan sales channels, documentation, support, update cycles, and audience growth before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Template Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner creator selecting a first product idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a paid Notion template idea. My audience is [audience], their main problems are [problems], and my skills are [skills]. Recommend three ideas and explain the strongest option.

prompt_templates.title: Design the Template Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Creator planning pages, docs, and bonus materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the structure for a Notion template about [topic]. Include the main dashboard, core pages, sample data, documentation, FAQ, and possible bonus assets.

prompt_templates.title: Create Pricing Tiers
prompt_templates.scenario: Seller deciding how to price one template or a bundle
prompt_templates.prompt: Create pricing tiers for my Notion template. It helps users [outcome], saves about [time saved], and includes [assets]. Recommend basic, pro, and premium tiers.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Channel Launch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operator launching across owned and marketplace channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a launch plan for a Notion template business using Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Notion Marketplace, and my own site. Include positioning, offer stack, content plan, support plan, risks, and metrics.

output_examples.input: I want to sell a Notion CRM template for freelancers.
output: Recommended positioning: a lightweight client pipeline for solo freelancers who need follow-up reminders and project visibility.
Package: dashboard, leads database, client records, project tracker, invoice status view, sample client data, setup guide, and FAQ.
Starting offer: free mini CRM as a lead magnet, paid pro version at a mid-tier price, and a premium bundle with email scripts.

output_examples.input: My template is finished, but I do not know where to sell it.
output: Use Gumroad for fast validation, Notion Marketplace for discovery, and an owned landing page for long-term brand control.
Prepare preview images, a short walkthrough video, clear refund terms, and documentation before listing.
Track visits, conversion rate, refund rate, support volume, and email signups during the first month.

output_examples.input: I am getting too many support questions after launch.
output: Create a setup checklist, searchable FAQ, short walkthrough videos, and a known-issues page.
Group repeated questions into documentation updates and product improvements.
Reserve direct support for paid tiers if support load starts reducing product work.

best_practices: Start with a specific buyer and problem before designing the Notion pages.
Include example data, onboarding notes, and documentation to reduce buyer confusion.
Use one owned channel and one marketplace channel so demand is not tied to one platform.
anti_patterns: Building a template before validating that a clear audience wants the outcome.
Pricing only by page count instead of time saved, business value, and support needs.
Launching without documentation, support boundaries, or a plan for future updates.

faq.question: Does this skill build the Notion template for me?
faq.answer: It helps design the product structure, offer, pricing, and launch plan. You still create the Notion workspace and assets.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, and the prompts are written for general assistant use.

faq.question: Does it connect to Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy?
faq.answer: No. It provides setup and launch guidance, but it does not call marketplace APIs or manage accounts.

faq.question: What type of creator benefits most?
faq.answer: It fits creators who understand a niche problem and want to package a Notion solution into a paid digital product.

faq.question: Does it guarantee revenue?
faq.answer: No. It improves planning and execution, but sales depend on demand, positioning, traffic, pricing, and product quality.

faq.question: Can it help after launch?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers support systems, documentation, template updates, bundles, and channel diversification.
